static_traits.name: Gu Rui
static_traits.family_status: 有一个Female儿;其他家庭情况Not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends are affected (self-isolates to avoid being hurt again); has a best friend living in the same neighborhood; friends and younger sister provide support
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;此前not yet有类似心理问题,not yet接受过心理咨询;一周前步行时脚踝受伤
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude,愿意配合(表示'准备好了');略显Anxiety;表达清晰;存在过度分析倾向;对积极反馈持怀疑态度

basic_info.main_problem: 在上一次步行时脚踝受伤,此后因not yet更谨慎而产生Self-blame and guilt,负性Automatic thoughts每日出现,影响日常活动与身心愉悦;同时在烹饪情境下持续出现Anxiety与Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: 因自责与负性思维影响心理健康与日常活动的愉悦而求助,希望通过咨询挑战和修正not合理想法,获得更平衡的视角并改善体验.
growth_experiences: 几年前在一次晚宴中为宾客烹饪时,烧糊了一道菜,整场聚会被来访者主观体验为'灾难'.自此之后,每次做饭都变得紧张和Anxiety,来访者常在烹饪中出现Self-doubt(如'I will definitely mess up''我做得not好'),并将小失误(如盐放多了,稍微过火)视为整餐失败.即便他人给予正向反馈,来访者也倾向于认为对方只是礼貌或安慰,从而negate积极反馈.这一事件对其日常生活与自我评价产生了持续影响.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough(容易把小错视为整体失败)
犯错说明我有问题/not负责任

special_situations.event: 上一次步行时脚踝受伤(not yet提前看到坑洞)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not提前发现风险并避免受伤,就说明我not负责任,我应该做得更好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly cautious while walking, slows down, even avoids going out to prevent being injured again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我本该更小心,这It is all my fault

special_situations.event: Cooking for others/回想过去晚宴烧糊一道菜
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一道菜出现错误,就意味着整餐失败,我就是一个糟糕的Chef
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding cooking for others; strictly relying on new recipes and seeking others' verification to reduce mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely mess up,我是个差劲的Chef

special_situations.event: Others' positive feedback or praise for the dishes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的赞美只是礼貌not是真实肯定,只有完全without误才算真正好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极反馈,继续自我批评,维持高标准以求'零错误'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是客套,并not是真的喜欢

special_situations.event: Seeing others walk or do physical activity
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I participate in similar activities, I am very likely to get injured again, so I should avoid them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces or avoids physical activity, keeps distance from friends to lower risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I go and attend, something will happen / I will be hurt again

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen as competent (including as a cook and a father), and hopes to stay in control and reduce mistakes
core_conflict.fear: 害怕犯错导致他人失望或负面评价,或再次受伤;担心被视为not称职
defense_goal: Maintains control and improvement through self-criticism
回避高风险活动或Cooking for others来降低被评价与受伤的可能
以过度分析与理性化来压制情绪,缓解Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 容易犯错,需要完美的'糟糕的Chef/not称职者'
object_relations.object_representation: Others are harsh critics or superficially polite comforters
Family/children who may be disappointed and doubt one's ability

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others praise one's dishes or give positive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向于认为对方只是礼貌或安慰,真实评价可能是not佳(移情:将内在的negate投向他人)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和,先接纳对方反馈,再以开放式问题探询证据(如'你具体喜欢哪一点?'),避免立即negate;适度自我揭示当下的not安感.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 准备Cooking for others或回想晚宴烧糊菜的情境
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将外界的高标准与'零错误'规则内化,认为小失误等于整体失败(移情:Introjection的苛刻他人)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use支持性语气,邀请区分'外在标准'与'个人可行标准';鼓励具体化错误的影响范围,Guidance看见部分成功与改进点.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Seeing others do physical activity or recalling details of the ankle injury
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Avoids emotions through rational detailing and over-analysis, presetting the possibility of being injured again (transference: amplifying the sense of danger)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 保持稳定语速与Empathy语气,先镜映其担忧,再Guidance回到具体当下身体信号与安全行为;以小步行为实验替代长篇分析.

Relationship with friends affected,Reduced socializing活动
outcomes: Decreased enjoyment of life,活动减少

Treats a small mistake as failure of the whole meal; hard to gain a sense of meaning from positive feedback

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use'应该/必须更小心'的自我Demands
Treats zero mistakes as the only standard, errors mean failure

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive self-scrutiny and criticism before and after cooking
面对赞美时迅速Self-denial,难以接纳正向信息

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 认为他人的赞美只是礼貌或安慰,not是真心喜欢
Infers others' negative evaluations of him without evidence
